Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued, qualified maintenance 
 staff carry the suitable safety ID category,

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,

items:
Use standard personal safety 
 and healthy
 equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes, 
 goggles, protective clothing, rubber gloves
Don't smoke in the battery room.
Don't place any tools on top of battery cells (Danger of short circuit).
All tools will be used must be insulated.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment
Work to be Carried Out
Disconnect AC supply of battery charger.

Inspect out side battery containers for cracks and leakage of 
 electrolyte.

Inspect contact area of inter connection, lugs, terminal 
 connections, tightening and clean by plastic bristle 
 brush, then coated with a thin film of No - ox - ID grease.

Clean a top of battery containers with clear water and 
 neutralized acid spilt only with a solution of sodium bicarbonate baking soda.

Inspect and record electrolyte level, density for each cell ( 
 level at 1/2" lowered from full mark level, 1.2 - 1.22 ).
Lubricate terminals for cells with a thin film of Vaseline.

Record voltage / cell it should be ( 2.05 0.04 ) at 1. 21 , 77 
 ºf .

If cell voltage more than 0.04 below min. float voltage put 
 battery under equalize charge.

Record overall voltage of battery it should be 2.05 x No. of 
 cell / battery if it is below put under equalizing.
Replace defective battery.
Measure internal resistance per cell.
Check ventilation and clean battery house.
